0.name: Bagyo Ka Lang, Pinoy Kami
0.desc: A Data Science / Web Development project that involves looking into Internal Displacements due to Natural disasters between the Philippines and other SEA countries, with a complete step by step process from Data Gathering to Data Analysis.

1.name: ReciKeep
1.desc: Fullstack Decentralized Web App that uses the Arbitrum Sepolia testnet that was developed in Solidity with a web app that uses SvelteKit. Note that you may need a MetaMask wallet in order to view the contents of the DAPP on https://blk-recikeep.vercel.app/.

2.name: Toxic Speech Classifier
2.desc: A machine learning model that takes in texts similar to Tweets, and determines whether the Tweet is toxic or not using the Multinomial Naive Bayes classifier, which proved to be more accurate than the t-SNE K-means clustering algorithm

3.name: IwasSingko
3.desc: A 2-dimensional Godot Game that follows the genre of Bullet Hell games, with the main character serving as a student that aims to have a high score or final grade

4.name: ReciPeek
4.desc: IOT system that takes in the weight of an ingredient on the sensor as input, stores it to the pantry, and showcases the list of available recipes to cook. The system uses an ESP32 controller and has Firebase store data based on API requests.

5.name: Downloads Sorter
5.desc: Python script that moved my files from an internal downloads folder into an external directory with error logging. Used every now and then to keep my SSD clean.

6.name: Portfolio Website
6.desc: This very website! Fully designed and built by me with SvelteKit, TypeScript, and hand-rolled CSS, with JSON files as the (temporary) data management system.

7.name: Developer Blog
7.desc: A blog page that displays the projects that I'm working on, mainly those that don't have a UI such as data analysis and data engineering. Currently being updated, with the latest published chapter handling Linear Optimization for Meal Optimization.

8.name: Automated TikTok Vlog Creator
8.desc: An automated batch and Python script that stitches together videos where the pipeline automatically takes them from Google Photos and creates a stitched up video log from the videos that were taken the day before. Currently being updated, mainly working on improving the video editing side of the Python script.

9.name: Meal Optimizer
9.desc: A web app that solves a linear program live in the browser to hit your daily macro targets (protein, fiber, energy, potassium) for the least money. Log what you've already eaten — or photograph your plate to have a local vision model estimate the macros — and it re-solves for the cheapest way to finish the day. Ported from a PuLP/CBC Jupyter notebook to a JavaScript simplex solver, with an optional FastAPI backend for accounts, sync, and photo scanning.

10.name: Triviadle
10.desc: A daily trivia x Wordle game: one shared question a day, five guesses, with progressive per-letter feedback and clues that ramp up each turn. Includes accounts, streaks and stats, opt-in practice modes, and a community-driven, scraped-and-LLM-generated question pipeline. Built as a monorepo with a React SPA and a FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend, deployed to AWS via Terraform.
